standard_prerequisites.name: For a perfect complex F on a quasi-compact open of an affine scheme, the object F plus a shifted finite locally free module is the restriction of a perfect complex on the whole scheme
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the initial perfect extension E whose restriction is F[r] plus F.

standard_prerequisites.name: Maps of perfect complexes can be lifted along restriction to the open, with prescribed restriction
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the endomorphism alpha of the extension acting as the projection onto the locally free summand over U.

core_obligations: By Lemma lift-perfect-complex-plus-locally-free there is a perfect object E of D(O_X) with E|_U = F[r] plus F for some finite locally free O_U-module F (proof lines 3622-3626).
By Lemma lift-map find a morphism of perfect complexes alpha : E_1 to E with E_1|_U isomorphic to E|_U and with alpha|_U the matrix (id on F[r], 0 on F) acting on F[r] plus F (proof lines 3627-3638).

The cone on alpha is a perfect complex on X whose restriction to U is (F[r] plus F) plus (F[r] plus F)[-1] restricted appropriately; the summand F contributes F plus F[1], giving the required extension of F plus F[1] (proof lines 3638-3641).
proof_roadmap: Extend F plus a locally free summand to a perfect E (proof lines 3622-3626).
Lift the projection endomorphism onto the locally free summand (proof lines 3627-3638).
Take the cone as the required extension (proof lines 3638-3641).
